meta.title: AG Grid vs Kendo UI: Features, Pricing and Licensing
meta.description: Compare AG Grid and Kendo UI Grid feature by feature: framework support, free and paid features, large datasets, pricing and licensing.

hero.heading: AG Grid vs Kendo UI
hero.subHeading: Compare AG Grid vs Kendo UI Grid on framework support, free and paid features, large datasets, pricing and licensing.

shortAnswer: AG Grid is one data grid for React, Angular, Vue and plain JavaScript, with a free, MIT-licensed Community edition. Kendo UI Grid, from Progress Telerik, is sold as separate libraries for React (KendoReact), Angular, Vue and jQuery. Only the React library has a free tier, KendoReact Free, which includes the Grid with a reduced feature set; the Angular, Vue and jQuery grids need a trial or paid licence. In KendoReact, row virtualisation, locked (pinned) columns, grouping and Excel export are premium features, and pivoting and tree data are separate components. AG Grid Community includes row virtualisation, column pinning and CSV export, and [AG Grid Enterprise](/license-pricing/), a paid perpetual licence, adds row grouping, pivoting, tree data and Excel export.

faq.question: What is a Kendo grid?
faq.answer: Kendo UI Grid is a data grid component from Progress Telerik. It is sold as separate libraries for React (KendoReact), Angular, Vue and jQuery.

faq.question: Is Kendo grid free?
faq.answer: The React version has a free tier, KendoReact Free, with a reduced set of Grid features. Kendo UI for Angular, Vue and jQuery need a paid licence.

faq.question: Does AG Grid work with Angular?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid has official packages for Angular, React and Vue, and can be used with plain JavaScript.

faq.question: Can I use AG Grid for free?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid Community is free and open source under the MIT licence, including for commercial use. AG Grid Enterprise is a paid licence that adds features such as row grouping, pivoting, Excel export and the Server-Side Row Model.

faq.question: Does AG Grid include pivoting and tree data?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid Enterprise includes pivoting and tree data in the grid itself. Kendo provides them as separate components, PivotGrid and TreeList.

proseClaims.claim: Kendo UI Grid is sold as separate libraries for React (KendoReact), Angular, Vue and jQuery; the Kendo UI subscription covers all four.
KendoReact Free includes the Grid with a reduced feature set, is free for commercial use under a proprietary licence, and has community forum support.
All Kendo UI for Angular components need a trial or commercial licence.
The Kendo UI for Vue Grid needs a commercial or trial licence key.
Kendo UI Core is free and open source (Apache 2.0) and does not include the Grid.
In KendoReact, row virtualisation, grouping, multi-column sorting and Excel export are premium, and column virtualisation and CSV export are in KendoReact Free.
KendoReact pivoting and tree data are separate PivotGrid and TreeList components.
KendoReact TreeList is a separate premium component.
KendoReact themes include Default, Bootstrap, Material, Fluent and Meridian.
The KendoReact MCP server needs an active subscription or trial licence; perpetual licences do not grant access to the AI tools.
KendoReact and Kendo UI are sold as annual subscriptions per developer, with Lite, Priority or Ultimate support.
